data.value:
The effective date of enrollment shall be on the date the provider attains participating status as determined by DHCF under Federal and District regulations. A provider who has been approved is eligible to be reimbursed only for services furnished on or after the effective date of the enrolled provider's executed agreement with DHCF, and only for those services the provider is eligible to render. The effective date is determined by the date that the application is approved except in extenuating circumstances.

Exception for Providers submitting Emergency Out-of-State applications: The enrollment term only covers the date(s) of service stated on the submitted medical claims form(s). Please note claims may be submitted up to 365 days from the date the service was rendered
